About ParlayOS

ParlayOS is a picks and analytics tool built by someone who bets his own parlays and got tired of staking them all the same way. This page exists to make one thing unmistakably clear before you subscribe: a model percentage on a single game is not the same number as your chance of winning a parlay built from several of them.

A "73% model" pick is not a 73% parlay - combining legs multiplies their probabilities. Even stacking eight strong 65% picks leaves ~3% chance the whole ticket cashes. At a typical 57% per leg, eight legs is closer to 1-in-90.

Because of that, the founder sizes longer parlays much smaller than short ones - roughly a dime (one-tenth) of a full stake on 7+ leg tickets - not because the model is wrong, but because the hit rate of a long parlay is genuinely low.

* * What it does: * 1) When the MLB schedule calendar renders for a team+month that has no * inline PARLAYOS_DATA.schedules coverage, fetches the team's real * schedule for that month from statsapi.mlb.com (CORS-friendly). * 2) Normalizes the response into the same shape used by the inline data: * { date, opp, home, result, myScore, oppScore, time } * 3) Merges into window.PARLAYOS_DATA.schedules[teamAbbr] (de-duped by date+opp) * so subsequent renders use the cached data. * 4) Triggers a re-render of the visible calendar mount(s). * * Implementation note: setCalState is defined inside an IIFE in the page, * so we cannot hook window.setCalState. Instead, we listen for click events * on .cal-nav and .tappable-team elements (capture phase, runs before the * page's own handler), record the click target, then after the page's handler * finishes (setTimeout 0), check if data is missing and fetch if needed. */ (function(){ 'use strict'; if(window.__PARLAYOS_LIVE_SCHED_FETCHER) return; window.__PARLAYOS_LIVE_SCHED_FETCHER = true; // MLB team abbreviation -> statsapi teamId const MLB_TEAM_IDS = { ARI:109, ATL:144, BAL:110, BOS:111, CHC:112, CWS:145, CIN:113, CLE:114, COL:115, DET:116, HOU:117, KC:118, LAA:108, LAD:119, MIA:146, MIL:158, MIN:142, NYM:121, NYY:147, OAK:133, PHI:143, PIT:134, SD:135, SF:137, SEA:136, STL:138, TB:139, TEX:140, TOR:141, WSH:120 }; // Track in-flight requests to avoid duplicate fetches const inflight = new Set(); // keys: "STL-2026-07" function monthBounds(yr, mo){ // mo is 0-indexed const start = new Date(yr, mo, 1); const end = new Date(yr, mo + 1, 0); // last day of month const fmt = d => `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`; return { startDate: fmt(start), endDate: fmt(end) }; } function normalizeOppName(name){ if(!name) return ''; const map = { 'Diamondbacks':'ARI','D-backs':'ARI','Braves':'ATL','Orioles':'BAL', 'Red Sox':'BOS','Cubs':'CHC','White Sox':'CWS','Reds':'CIN','Guardians':'CLE', 'Rockies':'COL','Tigers':'DET','Astros':'HOU','Royals':'KC','Angels':'LAA', 'Dodgers':'LAD','Marlins':'MIA','Brewers':'MIL','Twins':'MIN','Mets':'NYM', 'Yankees':'NYY','Athletics':'OAK','A\'s':'OAK','Phillies':'PHI','Pirates':'PIT', 'Padres':'SD','Giants':'SF','Mariners':'SEA','Cardinals':'STL','Rays':'TB', 'Rangers':'TEX','Blue Jays':'TOR','Nationals':'WSH' }; for(const [full, abbr] of Object.entries(map)){ if(name.includes(full)) return abbr; } return name.split(' ').slice(-1)[0].slice(0,3).toUpperCase(); } function buildScheduleEntry(gameDate, teamAbbr, game){ try{ const awayId = game.teams?.away?.team?.id; const homeId = game.teams?.home?.team?.id; const teamId = MLB_TEAM_IDS[teamAbbr]; if(!teamId) return null; const isHome = homeId === teamId; const oppId = isHome ? awayId : homeId; if(!oppId) return null; const oppName = isHome ? (game.teams?.away?.team?.name||'') : (game.teams?.home?.team?.name||''); let opp = normalizeOppName(oppName); if(!opp || opp.length > 3){ for(const [abbr, id] of Object.entries(MLB_TEAM_IDS)){ if(id === oppId){ opp = abbr; break; } } } const status = game.status?.detailedState || game.status?.statusCode || ''; const isFinal = /final|game over|completed/i.test(status); const isPostponed = /postponed|suspended|cancelled|canceled/i.test(status); const isInProgress = /in progress|live|warmup|pre-game/i.test(status); const linescore = game.linescore || {}; let myScore = null, oppScore = null; if(isFinal || isInProgress){ const awayRuns = parseInt(linescore.teams?.away?.runs ?? game.teams?.away?.score ?? '', 10); const homeRuns = parseInt(linescore.teams?.home?.runs ?? game.teams?.home?.score ?? '', 10); if(!isNaN(awayRuns) && !isNaN(homeRuns)){ if(isHome){ myScore = homeRuns; oppScore = awayRuns; } else { myScore = awayRuns; oppScore = homeRuns; } } } let result = null; if(isFinal && myScore !== null && oppScore !== null){ if(myScore > oppScore) result = 'W'; else if(myScore < oppScore) result = 'L'; else result = 'T'; } let time = ''; if(!isFinal && !isPostponed && game.gameDate){ try{ const d = new Date(game.gameDate); time = d.toLocaleTimeString('en-US',{hour:'numeric',minute:'2-digit',timeZone:'America/New_York'}); }catch(e){} } if(isPostponed){ return { date: gameDate, opp, home: isHome, result: null, myScore: null, oppScore: null, time: '', postponed: true }; } return { date: gameDate, opp, home: isHome, result, myScore, oppScore, time }; }catch(e){ console.warn('[LiveSched] buildScheduleEntry err', e); return null; } } async function fetchTeamMonth(teamAbbr, yr, mo){ const teamId = MLB_TEAM_IDS[teamAbbr]; if(!teamId) return []; const key = `${teamAbbr}-${yr}-${String(mo+1).padStart(2,'0')}`; if(inflight.has(key)) return []; inflight.add(key); try{ const { startDate, endDate } = monthBounds(yr, mo); const url = `https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule?sportId=1&teamId=${teamId}&startDate=${startDate}&endDate=${endDate}&hydrate=team,linescore,probablePitcher`; const res = await fetch(url); if(!res.ok){ console.warn('[LiveSched] fetch failed', res.status); return []; } const data = await res.json(); const dates = data.dates || []; const out = []; dates.forEach(d => { const gameDate = d.date; (d.games || []).forEach(g => { const entry = buildScheduleEntry(gameDate, teamAbbr, g); if(entry) out.push(entry); }); }); console.log(`[LiveSched] Fetched ${out.length} games for ${teamAbbr} ${yr}-${mo+1}`); return out; }catch(e){ console.warn('[LiveSched] fetch error', e); return []; }finally{ inflight.delete(key); } } function mergeIntoSchedules(teamAbbr, newGames){ try{ if(!window.PARLAYOS_DATA) window.PARLAYOS_DATA = {}; if(!window.PARLAYOS_DATA.schedules) window.PARLAYOS_DATA.schedules = {}; const existing = window.PARLAYOS_DATA.schedules[teamAbbr] || []; const byKey = new Map(); existing.forEach(g => { const k = `${g.date}|${g.opp}|${g.home?1:0}`; byKey.set(k, g); }); newGames.forEach(g => { const k = `${g.date}|${g.opp}|${g.home?1:0}`; const cur = byKey.get(k); if(!cur){ byKey.set(k, g); } else if((!cur.result && g.result) || (cur.myScore === null && g.myScore !== null)){ byKey.set(k, g); } }); const merged = Array.from(byKey.values()).sort((a,b) => (a.date||'').localeCompare(b.date||'')); window.PARLAYOS_DATA.schedules[teamAbbr] = merged; return merged; }catch(e){ console.warn('[LiveSched] merge error', e); return []; } } function hasDataForMonth(teamAbbr, yr, mo){ try{ const sched = window.PARLAYOS_DATA?.schedules?.[teamAbbr] || []; if(!sched.length) return false; const moStr = String(mo + 1).padStart(2, '0'); const prefix = `${yr}-${moStr}`; return sched.some(g => String(g.date||'').startsWith(prefix)); }catch(e){ return false; } } // Re-render the visible calendar mount(s) function rerenderCalendar(league){ try{ if(typeof renderLeagueSchedule !== 'function') return; const mounts = [ league + 'ScheduleMount', league + 'ModalScheduleMount', league + 'InlineScheduleMount' ]; mounts.forEach(id => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if(el && el.offsetParent !== null){ try{ renderLeagueSchedule(league, id); }catch(e){} } }); }catch(e){ console.warn('[LiveSched] rerender err', e); } } // Check the current MLB calendar state and fetch missing data if needed function checkAndFetchMissing(){ try{ const st = window.parlayosCalendarState?.mlb; if(!st) return; const teamFilter = st.team; const yr = st.year; const mo = st.month; if(!teamFilter || !MLB_TEAM_IDS[teamFilter]) return; if(!yr || mo === undefined || mo === null) return; if(hasDataForMonth(teamFilter, yr, mo)) return; console.log(`[LiveSched] No data for ${teamFilter} ${yr}-${mo+1}, fetching...`); fetchTeamMonth(teamFilter, yr, mo).then(games => { if(games.length){ mergeIntoSchedules(teamFilter, games); rerenderCalendar('mlb'); } }).catch(e => console.warn('[LiveSched] checkAndFetch err', e)); }catch(e){ console.warn('[LiveSched] checkAndFetchMissing err', e); } } // Public API window.PARLAYOS_LIVE_SCHED = { fetchTeamMonth, mergeIntoSchedules, hasDataForMonth, rerenderCalendar, checkAndFetchMissing, MLB_TEAM_IDS }; // Listen for clicks on calendar nav buttons and tappable teams. // Use capture phase so we run BEFORE the page's own handler, then // schedule the check for after the page's handler updates the state. document.addEventListener('click', function(e){ const nav = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.cal-nav'); if(nav){ const league = nav.getAttribute('data-league') || 'mlb'; if(league === 'mlb'){ // After the page's click handler updates state + re-renders, check for missing data setTimeout(checkAndFetchMissing, 50); setTimeout(checkAndFetchMissing, 300); // second check in case render is slow } return; } const teamEl = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.tappable-team'); if(teamEl){ const league = teamEl.getAttribute('data-league') || 'mlb'; if(league === 'mlb'){ setTimeout(checkAndFetchMissing, 50); setTimeout(checkAndFetchMissing, 300); } return; } const clearBtn = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.clear-team-btn'); if(clearBtn){ // Clear filter - no fetch needed, just let page re-render return; } }, true); // capture phase // Also hook the modal open by observing DOM mutations. // When mlbModalScheduleMount appears (modal opens), check for missing data. const observer = new MutationObserver(function(mutations){ for(const mut of mutations){ mut.addedNodes.forEach(node => { if(node.nodeType !== 1) return;
